name: @devantage/docscanify-mcp

tools.name: scan_document
tools.description: Scans a document out of a photo, like a "CamScanner" app: detects the edges of the document, crops it, corrects its perspective, optionally reduces the noise, sharpens, rotates and applies a grayscale or black and white filter, and returns it as a PDF or an image, with the corners it was cropped from and, for a PDF, where it was placed on the page (to position signatures or stamps).

imageBase64.description: The image file (JPG, PNG, WebP and other common formats) in base64, or as a data URL. Send exactly one of imageBase64, imageUrl or imagePath

imageUrl.description: An http or https URL the server downloads the image from

imagePath.description: Path of the image on the machine of the server. Only with the stdio transport

fileName.description: Name of the output file. Default: the name of the image with the extension of the output format, or "scan"

outputFormat.description: pdf returns the scanned document inside a PDF page; image returns only the scanned image (JPEG, or PNG for the bw filter). Default: pdf

filter.description: none keeps the colors, grayscale removes them, bw is a black and white document mode (adaptive threshold). Default: none

noiseReduction.description: Whether to smooth the noise of the document, preserving the edges of the text. Default: false

rotation.description: Rotates the scanned document clockwise, in degrees. Default: 0

pageSize.description: PDF only. a4, letter, or image (page sized to the image at 150 DPI). Default: a4

margin.description: PDF only. Page margin in points (1/72 in). Default: 0

maxDimension.description: Downscales the image so its longest side is at most this size (px) before processing. Saves memory. Default: 3000

jpegQuality.description: Quality of the JPEG image. Not used by the bw filter, which is encoded as PNG. Default: 85

onNotDetected.description: What to do if no document is detected: error fails the call, original uses the whole image. Default: error

outputPath.description: Also saves the result on the machine of the server: a file path, or a directory to save it in with fileName. Only with the stdio transport
